title: Interleaved tree from a seed tuple
statement: For each ordered quadruple of elements of a three-element set, define a decision tree on nine sign coordinates by taking the three block indices determined by the first entry and assigning the remaining entries as the corresponding leaf seeds in those blocks. The resulting tree is the ordered interleaving of the three block trees.
hypotheses_covered: Seed is an ordered quadruple of elements of a three-element set
caveat: The rules determining the block indices and leaf seeds are referenced but not defined in the supplied definitions.
